resumeText:
Sneha Kulkarni | Mumbai | sneha.kulkarni@example.com | +91 98200 00000

EDUCATION
B.Com (Banking and Insurance), Ramnarain Ruia Autonomous College, University of Mumbai, 2026 | CGPA 8.4/10
HSC (Commerce), 2023 | 86%

INTERNSHIPS
KYC Operations Intern, Sahyadri Shared Services Pvt Ltd (bank back office), Navi Mumbai | May 2025 - July 2025 (10 weeks)
- Verified PAN, Aadhaar and address proofs for 400 savings account applications against the bank checklist.
- Screened new customer names against sanctions and PEP lists in the screening tool and flagged 6 possible matches to the team lead.
- Maintained a daily Excel tracker of pending KYC files and their ageing for the operations manager.
- Sent back incomplete applications to branches with a short note on the missing documents.

Summer Intern, Konkan Urban Co-operative Bank, Thane | June 2024 - July 2024 (6 weeks)
- Helped branch staff with re-KYC of 120 old accounts and updated customer details in the core banking system.

PROJECTS
- Final-year project: Wrote a 40-page report on PMLA 2002 and the RBI KYC Master Direction, comparing customer due diligence rules for low and high risk customers.
- Case study for the Banking Law course: Studied how a 2023 mule-account fraud ring moved money through student accounts and listed the red flags a bank could have caught.

CERTIFICATIONS AND COURSEWORK
- NISM-style Anti Money Laundering basics (online, IIBF short course), 2025
- Coursework: Banking Law and Practice, Financial Accounting, Risk Management in Banks

SKILLS
KYC documentation, Sanctions and PEP screening, Transaction monitoring (basics), MS Excel (VLOOKUP, pivot tables), MS Word, English, Hindi, Marathi

ACTIVITIES
- Presented the PMLA project findings to 60 students and faculty at the department research day.
- Treasurer, Commerce Students' Association, 2024-25.
